latest_release.name: Lichii nx2 build 117 (89440b2)
latest_release.body:
> **AMD regression fix.** Build 116 crashed on AMD Radeon RX 6000 cards and older while Ocarina of Time built its shaders after boot. This build fixes that. Everything else is the same as build 116: see the [build 116 release notes](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/tag/build-116) for the full changelog.

> **Recommended download: the PGO build.**

## What's changed

- **Fixed the AMD crash from build 116** ([#657](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/657)). On the Windows driver, RX 6000 (RDNA2), RX 5000 (RDNA1), Vega and Polaris cards crashed in `amdvlk64.dll` during the Ocarina of Time shader build. The driver reports matrix-core support on these cards even though they have none, so the faster matrix path from #583 now only runs on RDNA3 and newer. RX 7000/9000 and NVIDIA are unchanged. Thanks to nlz242 for bisecting it and testing the fix on an RX 6800 XT.

## Common issues

- **White streaks or trails at night in Ocarina of Time (Navi, fireflies, smoke):** turn off *Emulation → Configure → Graphics → Use NVIDIA DLSS in place of a game's DLSS*. This comes from DLSS, and a fix is being tested.

## Known issues

- Splatoon Raiders: characters look too dark, there is a green tint and FPS is lower than in earlier builds. This is being investigated.

---

Automatic build of `nx2` at 89440b29a90708c0fefc126b2bd8c7a64a996bdd.

## Linux

Linux packages come as an AppImage (self-contained, needs glibc 2.39 or newer: Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, Debian 13, Arch) and a tar.gz (uses your system libraries, so Qt 6 and the usual libraries must be installed).

| Build Type | Standard | PGO (Recommended) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| amd64 | [AppImage](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-linux-x86_64.AppImage) · [tar.gz](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-linux-x86_64.tar.gz) | [AppImage](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-linux-x86_64-pgo.AppImage) · [tar.gz](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-linux-x86_64-pgo.tar.gz) | Make the AppImage executable (`chmod +x`) and run it |
| ARM (aarch64) | [AppImage](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-linux-aarch64.AppImage) · [tar.gz](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-linux-aarch64.tar.gz) | [AppImage](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-linux-aarch64-pgo.AppImage) · [tar.gz](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-linux-aarch64-pgo.tar.gz) |  |

## Windows

Windows packages are in-place zip files: extract and run `lichii.exe`, or `eden-cli.exe` from a terminal.

| Build Type | Standard | PGO (Recommended) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| amd64 / x86_64 | [zip](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-windows-x86_64.zip) | [PGO zip](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-windows-x86_64-pgo.zip) | Both built with clang-cl and ThinLTO; the PGO zip adds a profile trained on Ocarina of Time |

## macOS

| Build Type | Standard | PGO (Recommended) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| arm64 (Apple Silicon) | [zip](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases/download/build-117/lichii-macos-arm64.zip) |  | macOS 15 or newer. Not notarized: right-click and choose Open the first time, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine lichii.app`. `eden-cli` is inside the app, in `Contents/MacOS` |

The PGO builds are the same programs compiled with profile-guided optimization. Linux uses clang with Eglantine's profile; Windows uses clang-cl and ThinLTO with a profile trained in Lichii on Ocarina of Time, so other games gain less. Prefer them when your CPU supports it.

detail.readme_excerpt: # Lichii Lichii is an experimental, open-source Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator written in C++. It builds on Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi, preserving their contributions while developing this fork's game compatibility and renderer fixes. This is an independent fork, not an official release of those upstream projects. Lichii is not affiliated with Nintendo. Visit the [official Lichii website](https://lichii.zortos.me) to find games and compare community compatibility reports. ## Downloads and setup Download Lichii only from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Lichii has no other download site: archives offered elsewhere, such as lichii.org, are not built by this project, and one has been reported to install malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)). On Windows, extract the entire build archive and run **lichii.exe**. Only use games and system files you have legally obtained. Games, keys and firmware are not included. ### Existing saves and settings The rebrand intentionally retains the existing Eden/Eglantine data directories and configuration keys. It does not move or delete saves, settings or shader caches. Back up your saves before testing experimental builds. ## Compatibility and issue reports Compatibility and performance vary by game, hardware and driver. Rendering errors, stutters and crashes remain possible. Passing automated tests does not establish that a game renders correctly, and this project makes no universal frame-rate guarantee. Browse [community compatibility reports](https://lichii.zortos.me/reports) for results with each player's build and setup. Desktop reporting requires a build containing [PR #303](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/303) and is not available in build 88. In builds that include it, play and stop a Switch 2 game, then right-click that game and choose **Submit compatibility report**. Only the latest session in the current Lichii process is eligible. Confirm the matching website catalog entry and review the editable machine, game, setup, and enabled add-on details prefilled where available. Check the public preview and give explicit consent before submitting. Nothing uploads automatically, and the native v1 reporter does not read or upload logs or files. When [reporting an issue](https://github.com/zortos293/Eglantine/issues), include: - The exact build, game version, CPU, GPU and driver version. - Relevant settings and steps to reproduce the problem. - A screenshot and the log from the affected session, after checking it for personal information.
